QuestInfo.name: Cooking with Tangyoon
QuestInfo.0: Tangyoon the chef of Nautilus want to speak with you.
QuestInfo.1: Tangyoon wants to make more dishes for the hungry Pirates of the Nautilus. But he says he needs more people to cook. If you are someone who can make delicious food then go use the #bDimensional Mirror Teleport#k and get to Tangyoon's Kitchen.
QuestInfo.2: Help Tangyoon to make some dishes.

0.0: These scallywags are hungry no matter how much I feed them. But do they hire me an assistant? No! Ungrateful pirates... I oughtta just get some nobody like YOU to cook for them! Heeey... You know your way around a dutch oven?

yes.0: Take the #bDimensional Mirror#k to Tangyoon's Kitchen if you've got the guts interested! Let's show these pirates what a FEAST looks like.

no.0: No interest in cooking? I'll just tell the pirates to go drink sea water then.

1.0: No time for training sessions, rookie! I need you on that cutting board right away!
1.1: Let me know when you want to cook. You just need to be in #ba party of 3, Level 60 or higher#k. I don't want any kids losing their fingers in my kitchen.
